buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1. This procurement is being undertaken on a Proprietary Article Certificate (PAC) basis to ensure compati bility, standardisation, seamless integration, and lifecycle support with the existing Cisco network infrastru cture installed at IIT Hyderabad. 2. Only the following entities shall be eligible to participate in this tender: o M/s Cisco Systems Inc. (OEM); or o Authorized Partners/Authorized Distributors of M/s Cisco Systems Inc. in India. 3. Bidders other than the OEM shall submit a valid Manufacturer's Authorisation Form (MAF)/Authorization Certificate issued by M/s Cisco Systems Inc., specifically authorising the bidder to quote, supply, install, co mmission (where applicable), and provide warranty and after-sales support for the offered products in Indi a. 4. The authorisation shall be valid on the date of bid submission and shall clearly establish the bidder's aut horisation for the products offered against this tender. 5. The bidder shall ensure that all licenses, subscriptions, and support services (where applicable) are prov isioned directly by or through the OEM. 6. Bids submitted by firms other than M/s Cisco Systems Inc. or its authorised partners/distributors in India shall be treated as non-responsive and rejected during technical evaluation. 7. This tender is being floated as a Global Tender Enquiry (GTE). Accordingly, bidders irrespective of their l ocal content, including Non-Local Suppliers (local content below 20%), are eligible to participate, subject to compliance with the tender conditions.
